findings: Credit button has no implementation — The Credit button in the customer modal renders but does nothing. Add a click handler that opens a credit request modal, or remove the button if credit functionality is deferred.

Payment modal opened from customer modal lacks customer context — When the Payment button is clicked from the customer modal, setShowPaymentRequestModal(true) is called but setPaymentAmount is not pre-filled with selectedCustomer.totalAmount. Pre-fill paymentAmount with selectedCustomer.totalAmount.toString() when opening from customer modal.

Transaction records use inconsistent customer field names — New transactions use customerName field, but the Transaction interface declares both customer and customerName. The customer field is never populated. Remove customer from the interface or populate it consistently.
